description: This file defines classes, macros, and functions related to warning reporting control within a software system. It includes mechanisms for categorizing warnings, serializing/deserializing warning data, and managing warning categories and exclusions. The file also provides macros for reporting warnings and out-of-bounds conditions, as well as classes for handling warning categories and reporting logic.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategory
classes.description: Template class managing warning bounds and analysis for specific warning categories, including serialization, deserialization, and warning level checks.

classes.name: WarningReportingType
classes.description: Template class representing a warning reporting category, including analysis, serialization, and control functionalities.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton class acting as a proxy for warning reporting units, managing categories, exclusions, and event reporting.

classes.name: ExcludedWarnings
classes.description: Class managing lists of callsigns and modules excluded from warning reports.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures warning bounds for a category based on provided settings.

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.description: Returns the name of the warning category.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes a warning condition based on actual value and optional parameters, determining if a warning should be reported.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes warning category data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes warning category data from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts warning category data into a string representation.

methods.name: IsWarning
methods.description: Determines if the current warning level is considered a warning.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if the warning category is enabled.

methods.name: Enabled (setter)
methods.description: Enables or disables the warning category.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and revokes the warning category control.
